text: In NVAR, which part is actually trained from data?
choices: Only the linear readout weights W_out, via ridge regression (the feature map is fixed and deterministic)
The delay embedding and the readout, jointly by gradient descent
The recurrent reservoir weights, via backpropagation through time
Every polynomial coefficient is set by hand, with no data-driven fitting
explanation: Exactly as for an ESN, only the linear readout W_out is trained — here by ridge regression on the explicit polynomial features. The feature map itself is fixed and deterministic (no learning). There is no reservoir to backpropagate through (option 2), the delays/degree are hyperparameters not gradient-trained (option 1), and the coefficients ARE fit to data by ridge, not hand-set (option 3).
